PoH hashchain append and mixin functions, tests, and build rules using SHA-256.


## Files

- **[fd_poh.h](fd_poh.h.md)**: The `fd_poh.h` file provides a software-based implementation of the Proof-of-History hashchain, including functions for appending recursive hash operations and mixing in a 32-byte value.
